title: Reject duplicate source_id change keys and stray question-mark statuses
outcome: The closed source_id adapter accepts the owner's canonical distinct change records and refuses exact duplicates or non-porcelain uses of question marks without sorting, deduplicating or reimplementing Git judgment.
acceptance: After producer-owner agreement, exactly repeated (path,status,origin) keys and statuses containing question marks other than ?? are unavailable; distinct same-path records such as ?? followed by D-space remain preserved.
Focused strict-parser negative tests discriminate duplicate keys and stray-question-mark forms, with ordered same-path positive controls and full-object comparison unchanged.
